reasons.plausibility: Introducing pores into a dense, high-strength alloy will almost certainly reduce its strength and stiffness, and the claim that a porous network can maintain load-bearing capacity at 1000 °C without property loss contradicts well-established structure-property relationships in metallic materials.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and would decisively falsify the hypothesis, but the hypothesis itself is so fundamentally flawed that the test is not scientifically useful.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it proposes a method (adding porosity) that is known to degrade mechanical properties, especially at high temperatures, and does not address the core challenge of reducing density while maintaining strength.
